name: The Grand Hall
description: The heart of the campus, and the one room the Stillness never reached all the way into. The guild's name is cut over the door; the roll of every cycle you have spent is kept inside.

tiers.description: The hall stands. Guild identity, school of study, and the record of your cycles.
The hall doubles its long tables and its ambitions. The active party grows to three.
Banners, a dais, and room for every voice. The active party grows to four.
